featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited The Game Ranch located at A Wing, Rajan Pada, Mindspace, Malad West, Mumbai, and it turned out to be a really fun and enjoyable experience.

Ambience:
The place has a super lively and energetic vibe. It’s known for its gaming-themed concept, making it a great hangout spot with friends. The atmosphere is vibrant, youthful, and perfect if you’re looking to chill, play, eat, and have a good time all in one place.

Cuisine:
They serve a mix of continental-style comfort food, bar bites, and crowd-favorite dishes that pair really well with their drinks and mocktails.

What we tried:

Mocktails:
• Raspberry and Grapefruit Gimlet – Refreshing with a nice tangy twist
• Tinderella – Unique, well-balanced, and very enjoyable

Food:
• The Empire State Chicken Burger – Juicy, filling, and full of flavor
• Chicken Popcorn with Spice Remoulade – Crispy outside, tender inside, and the dip made it even better
• Tempura Fried Prawns – Light, crunchy, and perfectly cooked
• Chicken Kheema Pav – Spicy, comforting, and packed with taste

Dessert:
• Baked Philadelphia Cheesecake – Super creamy, rich, and perfectly sweet. A must-try for dessert lovers!

Service:
The service and management were good, staff was polite and attentive, which made the experience even better.

Overall:
If you’re in Malad West, this spot definitely deserves to be on your list — perfect for food, fun, and good vibes with friends.

Worst birthday experience ever.

Despite booking and paying in advance for a table and a bowling alley, we faced constant pushing and overcrowding (dhakka-mukki) throughout the evening. I raised the issue multiple times in advance with both the lady and male bouncers, yet every complaint was ignored.

Shockingly, one bouncer was openly encouraging other people to play for free on our paid bowling lane. PR staff casually brought their girlfriends to our table and bowling area, and one PR even took drinks from our table without permission.

What is most disturbing is that PRs, bouncers, and even one of the owners present at the time witnessed everything and chose to do nothing. They simply stood there and watched.

Let’s be honest — if such language had been used toward your sister or girlfriend, it would never have been tolerated. Stand for the truth.

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash is a great place if you’re looking for a solid gaming and entertainment experience. From bowling and cricket to go-karting, there’s a good mix of activities that can easily keep you engaged for 5–6 hours.

They also have 3–4 good VR experiences that are definitely worth trying. The arcade games are decent, but you can skip a few of them and spend that time (and money) on the bigger experiences instead.

The space is well laid out, and even when it gets busy, the crowd feels manageable. Another plus is that the food here is good, making it easy to take breaks between games without stepping out.

One tip — check for combo packages or offers before you start playing. They can help you save a fair bit compared to paying for individual games.

Overall, it’s a fun spot for a long outing with friends or family.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.

Had our office party at Dave & Buster’s Mumbai and it turned out to be a fantastic team outing spot. The combination of arcade games, bowling, food, music, and lively ambience made it a perfect venue for corporate gatherings and team bonding activities.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Dave & Buster’s, Infiniti Mall (Andheri West)!
The place is absolutely massive — around 22,000 sq. ft. of pure fun and food. The ambience is super high-energy — part carnival, part sports bar, part social lounge. You’ll find zones for arcade games, VR experiences, Nitro Bowling with cool lighting, hi-tech darts, and big screens showing live cricket, football & F1. Perfect for birthdays, group hangouts, or even a casual fun evening.
We tried quite a few things from the menu:
🥤 Dare Devil Mocktail, Fight Mode Mocktail, Purple Breeze Mocktail, Oreo Shake – all refreshing and perfectly balanced.
🍕 Farmhouse Flatbread (Veg) – crisp and loaded with toppings.
🍗 Chicken Wings and Game Day Grub Platter (Non-Veg) – juicy, flavorful, and great for sharing.
🍔 Brekky Smash Chicken Burger – one of the best!
🌯 Veg Paneer Wrap and Creamy Garden Pasta – delicious and satisfying.
🍫 Tiramisu & Smoor Chocolate Cheesecake were the perfect sweet endings.
They’ve got a dedicated food & snack area, VR and arcade sections, bowling lanes, and live sports screening, making it one of the best entertainment spots in Andheri West.
Service was quick, staff were friendly, and the overall vibe was fun and energetic.
💡 Tip: Come in groups, buy a game card, and spend some time exploring — it’s totally worth it!
Highly recommend for anyone looking to combine great food, drinks, and games under one roof. 🎮🍔🍹

featured_reviews.name: Dwarkesh Diwan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Infinity Mall in Malad on a Tuesday, and the experience felt like walking into a calm, polished world tucked away from Mumbai’s usual rush. The first thing that struck me was how pleasantly uncrowded the mall was. Unlike weekends where most malls feel like a human maze, this weekday visit felt spacious, relaxed, and perfect for strolling without bumping into bags, elbows, or shopping carts. The floors gleamed like mirrors, reflecting the bright storefronts and giving the whole place a classy, open vibe.

The mall’s layout is clean and well-planned, with popular brands visible right from the central atrium. Stores like Azorte, Trends, Aurelia, Hush Puppies, Pantaloons and many others had bright, inviting displays. The storefronts look lively and modern, and the mall has enough variety to keep both window shoppers and serious shoppers satisfied.

The highlight, and something many malls don’t offer, is the indoor amusement zone with roller coaster rides. Yes, an actual roller coaster inside a mall! It adds a fun twist to the shopping experience, especially for families and kids. Even if you’re not riding, just watching the structure running overhead makes the place feel more like an entertainment hub than just a shopping center.

Food options are also impressive. I stopped by The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf for a warm drink, and the counters looked neat, well-lit, and inviting. The seating area felt relaxed and comfy enough to simply sit and enjoy the mall ambience.

Smart Bazaar inside the mall also deserves a mention. The store was well-stocked and offered some good deals (like Buy 1 Get 1 on water bottles), making it perfect for quick, affordable purchases.

Overall, Infinity Mall, Malad is surprisingly peaceful on weekdays, clean, modern, and full of good food, shopping, and entertainment options. If you want a stress-free mall experience in Mumbai, Tuesday at Infinity Mall is a great choice. Perfect for families, solo visitors, and anyone who enjoys a relaxed day out.
